The accessibility permission is required for the double tap to lock gesture. Any data acquired by Cesta Launcher via this service never leaves your device.
Please set Cesta Launcher as default first
Note: Tap on \'Cesta Launcher\' at the top of this Settings page to find your hidden apps.

Cesta Launcher uses the Accessibility Service API for one feature only: Double tap to lock. It lets Cesta Launcher lock your screen when you double tap on the home screen. 

The service only sees taps inside Cesta Launcher, and only uses them to lock your screen. It does not look at other apps or anything you type. 

No data is collected, stored or shared. Nothing leaves your device. 

Tap Accept, then turn on Cesta Launcher in your device's Accessibility settings.
